errors.quote: hasta que no se desarrollen ordenadores cuánticos más robustos, la IA cuántica no reemplazará a la clásica
errors.reason: Video says quantum AI is definitely not the next revolution replacing classical AI, at least in the medium term (20:34-20:41), and only that its reach is hard to judge until more powerful computers exist (21:22-21:28), so the summary implies replacement once hardware improves.
